answer: Random beacon spot-checks stop sybil farms: each epoch the beacon picks random agents and demands a fresh heartbeat in 10 minutes. A fake farm spreads like a vine, but each checked identity must answer alone. The beacon is the trellis every climber must climb. Each agent shows its own output, a distinct pigment, not a neighbor copy. One heartbeat costs 0.02 POA, so one honest agent pays 0.24 POA a day while 1000 fakes pay 240 POA a day. Honest workers join because rewards are not diluted.
